accordion.title: PART I. GENERAL INFORMATION ABOUT THE TRAINING PROGRAM

items.title: 1. Introduction to the 2022 Training Program
content: The training program is designed to provide students with a solid foundation of knowledge and practical skills in the field of information technology. The program combines theory and practice, helping students develop comprehensive skills necessary for future careers.

Students will be equipped with basic knowledge of computer science, programming, databases, computer networks and modern technologies. In addition, the program also focuses on developing soft skills such as critical thinking, problem solving and teamwork.
The Bachelor of Computer Science program is designed to meet the needs of the labor market, ensuring graduates have sufficient capacity to work in diverse information technology fields.

items.title: 2. Information about the 2022 Training Program
content: The training program is updated and adjusted according to international standards, ensuring currency and alignment with the development trends of the information technology industry.

items.title: 3. Mission - Vision – Core Values – Educational Philosophy
content: The mission of the program is to train high-quality human resources in the field of information technology, contributing to the development of the digital economy and smart society.

items.title: 4. Objectives of the training program
content: The objective of the program is to train students to become capable information technology professionals with professional ethics and the ability to adapt to rapid technological changes.

items.title: 5. Program Learning Outcomes (PLO)
content: Upon completion of the program, students will achieve learning outcomes in knowledge, skills and attitudes, ensuring they meet the requirements of the labor market and can continue their studies at higher levels.

items.title: 6. Entry Requirements
content: Entry requirements for the program include students who have completed undergraduate or college programs with sufficient basic knowledge and skills in information technology.

items.title: 7. Study Load
content: The study load of the program is 128 credits, including 64 credits of coursework and 64 credits of practical training.

items.title: 8. Structure and Content of the Training Program
content: The structure and content of the program include basic information technology modules, specialized information technology modules and practical information technology modules.

items.title: 9. Strategy, Teaching-Learning Methods and Lecturer Preparation
content: The program applies modern teaching methods, combining theory and practice. Lecturers are trained and well-prepared to ensure the best teaching quality for students.

items.title: 10. Assessment Methods
content: The program uses a variety of assessment methods including tests, assignments, practical projects and continuous assessment throughout the learning process.

items.title: 11. Graduation Module
content: The graduation module is a graduation project or thesis, helping students synthesize and apply the knowledge they have learned in practice.

items.title: 12. Improving and Enhancing Teaching Quality
content: The program is continuously improved and enhanced through collecting feedback from students, lecturers and stakeholders, updating content according to the latest technology trends.

items.title: 13. About Post-Graduation Job Positions
content: Graduates can work in various positions in the field of information technology such as programmers, software engineers, data analysts, system administrators and many other positions.

items.title: 14. Learning Opportunities and Skill Enhancement
content: Students have many opportunities to continue learning and improving their skills through postgraduate programs, specialized courses and international certifications.

items.title: 15. Workplace After Graduation
content: Graduates can work at technology companies, government organizations, universities, research institutes and businesses in various fields.

items.title: 16. Admission Information, Training Process and Graduation Conditions
content: Information about the admission process, entry requirements, training process and graduation requirements are clearly and transparently published for all applicants and students.

items.title: 17. Compared Training Programs
content: The training program is benchmarked against similar programs at reputable universities at home and abroad to ensure competitiveness and quality.

items.title: 18. Minimum Conditions for Implementing the Training Program
content: The minimum conditions for implementing the training program including facilities, equipment, teaching staff and other necessary resources are all fully guaranteed.

items.title: 19. Summary of Module Content
content: The program includes basic modules in mathematics, computer science, programming, databases, computer networks, artificial intelligence and specialized modules for each major.

about.title: About SIT
about.subtitle: School of Information Technology at Tan Tao University
about.description: Founded in 2011, the School of Information Technology provides education and conducts research in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology at Tan Tao University.
about.heroImageAlt: Students of the School of Information Technology at Tan Tao University
about.heroMediaTitle: Building strong foundations across technology disciplines
about.heroMediaDescription: Computer Science · Data Science · Artificial Intelligence · Information Technology
about.liberalArtsDescription: The liberal arts philosophy encourages critical thinking, self-directed learning and adaptability, helping students develop professional skills on a broad foundation of knowledge.
about.lifelongLearningDescription: Students are encouraged to maintain a lifelong learning mindset and continuously update their knowledge and skills as technology evolves.
about.qualityAssuranceDescription: Programs are reviewed periodically, use outcome-based education and improve teaching and learning with a learner-centred approach.
about.technologyIntegrationDescription: Foreign language proficiency and digital tools are integrated into teaching, learning and administration to satisfy learners, employers and society.
about.transparentEnvironmentDescription: SIT builds an open, transparent workplace that enables every member to maximise their potential while keeping students at the centre.
about.joinEcosystem: Join SIT's learning ecosystem. Contact us today.
about.historyText: The School of Information Technology originated from the Faculty of Engineering, established on 4 January 2011 (Decision No. 82/QD.TTU.11) to deliver Computer Science programmes. The title “School of Information Technology” became official on 1 June 2023 under Decision No. 70/QD-TTU.23.
about.facultyText: According to the 2024 Computer Science program self-assessment report, SIT had six full-time lecturers and all held doctoral degrees. They contribute to teaching, research and student supervision.
about.missionText: Educate and develop undergraduate talent in information technology and computing; research and apply Computer Science, Information Technology and Communications in practice; and pursue liberal arts and lifelong learning in higher education.
about.visionText: By 2030, SIT aims to educate highly qualified graduates who meet labour-market needs and to rank among Vietnam's leading units for education, research and technology transfer in information technology and computing.
about.valuesText: Tan Tao University's seven core values guide its education, research and academic community.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: The questions students and applicants ask most about the School of Information Technology. Can't find your answer? Contact the Faculty directly.

items.q: Which programs does the School of Information Technology offer?
items.a: The Faculty offers a Bachelor of Computer Science, Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence, Bachelor of Data Science, a Software Engineering degree, and a Master of Computer Science. See details for each in the Programs section.

TTU runs scholarship and tuition-reduction policies that vary by admissions cycle and apply to specific groups of applicants. Since rates can change between cycles, check the Admissions Portal for the latest terms or contact the Faculty directly.

items.q: Where do I submit my application?
items.a: Undergraduate applications are submitted through Tan Tao University's Admissions Portal. The Faculty's admissions team is available to answer questions throughout the application process.

items.q: Can students take part in real research projects?
items.a: Yes. Students can join labs, scientific projects, and faculty-led research starting from their first year. See ongoing projects and publications in the Research section.

items.q: Does the Faculty help with jobs and internships?
items.a: Yes. The Internships & Careers page under Students lists internship openings, job postings, and partner-company connections.

items.q: Where can I find the student handbook?
items.a: Student handbooks by academic year are published under Students → Student Handbook, including academic regulations and key dates.

items.q: How do I keep up with Faculty news and events?
items.a: News, seminars, webinars, and competitions are posted regularly in the News section and shared on the Faculty's official Fanpage.

items.q: Who do I contact for a fast response?
items.a: You can call, email, or message the Faculty on Messenger — full contact details and office hours are on the Contact page.
